catalog.method: Asset only: the app ships configfile.json (v1.01) in its APK and has NO live catalog endpoint; supplied FILE_ONLY
catalog.notes: The bundled catalog is an asset, NOT a live catalog; it is never served as a live catalog. 36 of the 57 V2Ray UUIDs share one marker UUID (12345678-1234-1234-1234567B9o); whether the app substitutes it at runtime is unconfirmed.

files.method: A .mehaf file is a standard v2ray config (a vless:// link or a plain JSON), NOT a proprietary-encrypted format; the supplied_bridge MehafVPN branch parses the link or JSON, with the configfile.json blob as last resort
